title: Notion insert_content with the ellipsis after parameter is deprecated in favor of position after_content
symptoms: insert_content using after with ellipsis text is flagged deprecated
position after_content with an anchor is rejected when markdown_version is not v2
cause: The ellipsis-based insert_content.after parameter was deprecated on 2026-11-24. The replacement position types after_content and before_content only work with markdown_version v2.
fix: Replace after with position of type after_content and an anchor string, and send markdown_version v2 on the request. Upgrade @notionhq/client to v5.32.0 or later for types.
affected: Update page markdown calls using insert_content.after; SDK @notionhq/client before v5.32.0 lacks the types
